Knowledge of ECSS, NASA, or equivalent aerospace standards is highly desirable. Fluent English skills. Eligibility to work in Germany. This role offers a rewarding mix of hospital-based and community practice within a team that values collegiality, shared expertise, and high quality service. Our gastroenterologists provide general gastroenterology and hepatology care through a referral-based practice that includes participation in the provincial Colorectal Cancer Screening Program. The group operates with a centralized referral system and a unified EMR (Accuro), which the successful candidate will be welcomed into. Additional GI subspecialty training is welcomed but not required. The division is supported by a colorectal surgeon with advanced IBD expertise. Clinical work includes inpatient consultations and participation in the GI on call rotation. A major expansion of cancer services is underway, with a new cancer centre - including radiation therapy - scheduled to open in 2028. The Hepatology/Viral Hepatitis Clinic offers specialized nursing support and FibroScan technology, with optional clinic participation. Interventional radiology services and rotating gastroenterology fellows further enhance the depth of practice. The department benefits from strong working relationships with general surgeons, GPs/hospitalists, and highly skilled RNs, creating a supportive and collegial clinical environment. Teaching opportunities are available through RIH’s affiliation with the UBC Faculty of Medicine, with involvement in training medical students and residents. Leadership development opportunities are available through Interior Health’s NAVIG8 Program. Locum opportunities are also available for those interested in short term or flexible work. Apply today to live, work, and play where others only vacation! It's better here! review_candidates.title: Ingénieur système – Intégration de systèmes
review_candidates.description: Fondée en 1998, Octasic est une société privée dont le siège social est situé à Montréal au Canada, avec des installations de Recherche et Développement au Canada et en Inde, ainsi qu'un réseau mondial de soutien aux ventes. Octasic est l'un des principaux fournisseurs de SoC (System on Chip), de logiciels et de plates-formes matérielles et logicielles intégrées pour les marchés mondiaux du sans fil et de passerelles multimédia. Nos plates-formes matérielles et logicielles sont à la base des systèmes sans fil de nouvelles générations destinés aux forces de Défense, aux Services de Police et aux agences de Sécurité Nationale. On Choisit Octasic Pour Un milieu de travail à la fine pointe de la technologie, en contact avec les experts du domaine et ce dans une entreprise en croissance; Des conditions de travail compétitives (salaires, avantages sociaux, une semaine payée entre Noël et le Jour de l’An, rabais d’abonnement au gym, programme d’achat d’action, programme de remboursement du transport collectif, douches sur place, collations et breuvages gratuits); Assurances complètes (médicales, dentaires et télémédecine); Une atmosphère de travail conviviale et collaborative avec plusieurs activités sociales tout au long de l’année; Travailler au sein d’une entreprise impliquée dans sa communauté (levées de fonds pour Le Phare Enfants et Familles); La proximité avec les différents services de transport en commun (secteur Angus, à dix minutes à pieds du métro Préfontaine). À Propos Du Poste L’ingénieur système est responsable de développer des concepts de solutions au niveau système et d’intégrer des systèmes multidisciplinaires complexes en capacités opérationnelles. En collaboration étroite avec les clients et les équipes d’ingénierie, l’ingénieur système transforme les besoins opérationnels en solutions déployables, dirige les activités d’intégration de systèmes, gère les interfaces entre les technologies, et définit les exigences système, les scénarios opérationnels et le comportement attendu des systèmes qui servent de base aux activités d’intégration, de vérification et de validation. L’ingénieur système fournit une orientation technique au niveau système à l’organisation de vérification et validation afin de s’assurer que les exigences système, les objectifs opérationnels et les attentes des clients sont vérifiés et validés avec succès. Ce rôle est axé sur les communications avancées, les SDR, les RF, le SIGINT, ainsi que les systèmes aéroportés, mobiles et critiques pour la mission, impliquant à la fois des technologies développées à l’interne et des technologies tierces. Responsabilités Développer des concepts de solutions au niveau système : Collaborer avec les clients et les parties prenantes afin de comprendre les objectifs de mission, les défis opérationnels et les environnements de déploiement; Traduire les besoins des clients en exigences au niveau système et en concepts de solutions; Évaluer les options techniques, les compromis et les approches de mise en œuvre; Participer aux démonstrations client, aux prototypes, aux déploiements pilotes et aux engagements techniques afin de valider les concepts de solutions et les exigences opérationnelles; S’assurer que les solutions proposées sont pratiques, réalisables et alignées sur les objectifs opérationnels. Intégrer Des Systèmes Complexes Diriger l’intégration du matériel, des logiciels, des RF, des réseaux et des technologies tierces dans des solutions système complètes; Définir et gérer les interfaces entre les sous-systèmes, les produits et les plateformes externes; S’assurer que l’architecture système, les interfaces et les approches d’intégration soutiennent les objectifs opérationnels et de performance; Identifier et résoudre les problèmes d’intégration, les risques techniques et les dépendances au niveau système; Diriger les activités de planification, d’exécution, de dépannage et de déploiement liées à l’intégration avec des équipes d’ingénierie multidisciplinaires; S’assurer que les systèmes intégrés répondent aux exigences opérationnelles, de performance et de mission. Fournir Un Leadership Technique Au Niveau Système Agir comme point de référence technique au niveau système auprès des équipes d’ingénierie multidisciplinaires; Favoriser l’alignement technique et soutenir une prise de décision éclairée en ingénierie; Diriger ou contribuer aux études techniques comparatives, aux revues et aux évaluations des risques; Piloter la stratégie de vérification et de validation en s’assurant que les exigences système, les scénarios opérationnels et les critères d’acceptation sont clairement définis, traçables et validés par des essais. Qualifications Baccalauréat en génie électrique, génie informatique, génie logiciel, génie des télécommunications, informatique ou discipline connexe; Expérience en intégration de systèmes matériels et logiciels complexes; Expérience dans la traduction de besoins clients ou opérationnels en solutions techniques; Solide compréhension de l’architecture système, des interfaces et des concepts d’ingénierie multidisciplinaire; Capacité à résoudre des problèmes techniques complexes dans plusieurs domaines technologiques; Excellentes compétences en communication et en leadership technique; Admissibilité à obtenir ou à maintenir une cote de sécurité canadienne Atouts Expérience avec les SDR, LTE, 5G, systèmes RF, SIGINT, communications tactiques ou technologies connexes; Expérience avec des déploiements aéroportés, mobiles, fixes ou critiques pour la mission; Expérience en intégration de matériel, de logiciels, de capteurs ou de plateformes réseau tierces; Familiarité avec la gestion des exigences, le contrôle des interfaces et les méthodologies d’ingénierie système; Expérience en soutien de programmes gouvernementaux, de défense, d’aérospatiale ou de sécurité publique. Profil De Réussite La réussite dans ce rôle se mesure par la capacité à développer des concepts de solutions au niveau système qui répondent à de réels besoins clients, à intégrer des technologies complexes dans des systèmes fiables et déployables, et à s’assurer que ces solutions sont vérifiées, validées et acceptées avec succès par les clients. La personne retenue est un penseur systémique capable de faire le lien entre les objectifs clients et l’exécution en ingénierie, tout en maintenant l’accent sur les résultats opérationnels et le succès de la mission.

review_candidates.description: Company Description MNASATI.COM empowers businesses by enabling them to create robust and secure e-commerce websites within 24 hours. Our platform helps clients discover new customers and significantly increase their sales. We focus on providing efficient, user-friendly solutions to boost online presence and drive business growth. At MNASATI.COM, we are committed to supporting businesses as they navigate the digital landscape. Role Description We are seeking a dynamic, proactive, and detail-oriented HR Officer to join our growing technology company. The successful candidate will support the company's HR operations, talent management initiatives, and employee experience, and contribute to a high-performance, innovative work environment. Qualifications & Requirements • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, or a related field. • 1–3 years of experience in Human Resources, preferably within the technology, digital, or fast-paced corporate sector. • Strong understanding of HR operations, employee relations, labor laws, and HR best practices. • Experience supporting recruitment and onboarding processes. • Familiarity with HRMS platforms and HR reporting tools. • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build positive relationships across all levels of the organization. • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively. • High attention to detail and ability to maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive employee information. • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to HR support and employee engagement. • Professional HR certifications (CHRM, CIPD, SHRM, PHRi, or equivalent) are considered an advantage. • Fluent in English; Arabic language proficiency is a plus. How to Apply: Interested candidates are invited to send their CV to Hr@mnasati.com with the subject line: Human Resources Executive

review_candidates.title: Head of Talent
review_candidates.description: We offer opportunities to do your life’s work while helping solve one of the most important technical and moral challenges of our time. Full-time, in-office in Emeryville, California. Be our founding Head of Talent. Own every open search end to end, from scoping to close, and build the hiring function the company grows on without lowering the bar. Key Responsibilities Own full-cycle recruiting for every open role, across formulation and computational chemistry, behavioral assay science, machine learning and computer vision, lab network operations, and global health and regulatory: scoping, sourcing, interviewing, offer design and close. Turn ambiguous mandates from the founder and technical leads into crisp role definitions, calibrated bars and structured interview loops, with scorecards, debriefs and calibration you run yourself. Build top of funnel from scratch: talent maps and warm pipelines across entomology, chemistry, machine learning and vector-control research, and the labs, companies and funders where that talent works. Run the searches that never move through a standard process: senior researchers and operators who are not looking, where timing, discretion, market intelligence and a tailored approach matter more than process. Close exceptional people who have other excellent options, on substance and relationship rather than pressure, by being fluent in the work and honest about the trade-offs. Stand up the recruiting infrastructure the company needs: applicant tracking, pipeline reporting, employer presence and a candidate experience that reflects the seriousness of the work. Own the people foundations that come with hiring: leveling, offer frameworks and a consistent bar across science, engineering and operations. Hire and lead recruiters if and when the team needs them. Qualifications Ten or more years in talent, including leading recruiting as a head of recruiting, director or founding recruiter at a research organization, frontier technology company or another environment with a famously high bar. Took an organization through rapid early scaling: joined when the team was small, built the recruiting function and its processes from scratch, and are energized rather than unsettled by doing it again. Personally hired senior scientists, engineers and operators, closing against offers from the best companies in the world. Track record of building relationships with hard-to-reach candidates who are not actively looking or who need a highly personalized process. Can hold your own in a substantive conversation about insect behavior, chemistry, machine learning and malaria vector control, enough to earn the trust of researchers and engineers. Operate with discipline, discretion and care without needing a large team around you. Desired Attributes Experience spanning recruiting and people operations, including leveling, compensation design and onboarding, so the hiring system and the employee experience grow together. Time in mission-driven organizations, and a record of hiring for first-of-their-kind roles. Experience advising founders on talent strategy, org design and compensation. Deep interest in the science, and in the people and institutions shaping vector control and crop protection.

review_candidates.title: Head of Sales
review_candidates.description: About Metasteps Metasteps is a no-code 3D space creation platform that lets educators, museums, creators, and more build interactive 3D experiences as simply as building a slideshow. With more than 1,500,000 exhibitions created on our platform, we are on a mission to put immersive 3D creation within everyone's reach, and we are growing fast. The Role: We’re looking for a driven Head of Sales to build and own the sales function at Metasteps and turn it into a structured, repeatable revenue engine. This is a builder role. You’ll be the first dedicated salesperson, responsible for setting up Pipedrive as the CRM backbone, defining the lead-to-deal pipeline, handling inbound yourself, and working with the CMO to launch outbound motions. If you thrive in zero-to-one environments where you get to define how things work, this is the role for you. Key Responsibilities: • Own the full sales cycle end-to-end: qualify inbound leads, run demos, negotiate, and close deals • Build the sales function from the ground up: create playbooks, set pricing and discounting guidelines, and establish the sales cadence • Set up and maintain Pipedrive as the single source of truth - design pipeline stages, lead scoring, deal tracking, and reporting dashboards • Develop outbound prospecting motions in close collaboration with the CMO - target lists, email sequences, LinkedIn outreach, and event follow-up workflows • Cover European and US markets, adapting messaging and timing to each region’s buying cycles and decision-making culture • Manage inbound leads with speed and discipline: qualify, route, follow up, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks • Own pipeline reporting and revenue forecasting - present weekly to the CEO and contribute to board-level updates • Represent Metasteps at trade shows, conferences, and partner events (occasional travel required) • Feed product insights from customer conversations back to the CTO to inform the roadmap • Partner closely with product and marketing to keep sales aligned with business priorities and go-to-market plans Knowledge, skills and abilities: • 5+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, with at least 2 years in a role where you built or significantly scaled a sales process • Proven track record of closing deals in the €5K–€100K+ ACV range, ideally selling to education, culture, or enterprise verticals • Hands-on experience with Pipedrive (or a comparable CRM like HubSpot or Salesforce) - you can set up pipelines, automations, and reporting yourself • Fluent English and Greek; additional languages (German, French, Spanish) are a strong advantage • Experience selling across European and/or US markets, with sensitivity to regional differences in procurement and decision-making • Comfort with outbound prospecting tools and techniques: LinkedIn Sales Navigator, sequencing tools (Clay, Apollo, HeyReach, Instantly) • Self-starter mindset; real ownership and autonomy come with this role • Excellent demo and presentation skills; ability to translate a technical product into business value for non-technical buyers • Strong analytical instincts and comfort working with data to inform pipeline decisions Nice to have: • Experience in Tech SaaS selling. EdTech, immersive tech, metaverse/3D, or digital culture experience a plus • Familiarity with PLG (product-led growth) motions and converting free-trial users into paying customers • Background working in a startup environment (Series A or earlier) where you wore multiple hats • Network in the European higher-education or museum/cultural-heritage sector a plus • Genuine curiosity about immersive technology and a desire to become a go-to voice on where the space is headed Why join us? We're a startup team working on something technically novel: real 3D space creation for the web, with a growing focus on education. You'll have genuine ownership of the entire sales function at a fast-growing tech startup with global traction, and a seat close to leadership, with real input into strategy and roadmap and a product. We offer a competitive compensation package and a hybrid work setup.

review_candidates.title: Head of Projects - Data Centres
review_candidates.description: About the Role The Head of Projects leads the safe, compliant and commercially successful delivery of capital asset upgrade, refurbishment and replacement projects across the DACH region, much of it within live, 24/7 data centre and critical environments. Working closely with the facilities management organisation as an internal client, the Head of Projects owns the regional P&L, grows the project pipeline, and acts as the recognised face of the project team in Germany. Key Responsibilities Lead multi-discipline delivery of modernisation, refurbishment, asset replacement and upgrade projects across Mechanical, Electrical, Civil and ICT infrastructure Deliver complex projects safely, on time, to budget and to a high standard, including works in energised critical environments Own the regional projects P&L, including budgeting, forecasting and financial oversight Grow revenue by mining existing maintenance-contract opportunities and introducing new clients Build and maintain a strong network of clients, consultants and contractors Recruit, develop and scale a high-performing team of project professionals (one Project Manager currently in place) Identify and manage technical, commercial, statutory and health & safety risk on every project Requirements Minimum 10 years' project delivery experience, including at least 4 years in a Senior Project Manager or team leadership role Proven data centre / critical environment project delivery experience (key requirement) Track record across modernisation, refurbishment, asset replacement and upgrade programmes spanning M&E, civil and ICT Strong asset management background covering upgrade and replacement programmes Demonstrated people leadership, with budget and P&L responsibility Solid financial acumen and project financial oversight Established network of clients, consultants and contractors Formal project management qualification (PMI, APM, relevant degree or equivalent) Good German and English Comfortable working close to the operational side of the business, treating the FM team as a collaborative internal client Package Base salary: approx €120,000 depending on experience 16% annual bonus Company car Hybrid working Location: Frankfurt, Germany About SSA Group SSA Group is a specialist recruitment consultancy focused on the data centre and construction sectors across Germany, Poland and wider Europe. We work with Tier 1 contractors, developers and owner-operators to place senior technical and commercial professionals.
